methods.frames: Decoded from delivered MP4. Overview select by frame index every rounded fps*12 frames. Detail at first and middle spoken cue end minus 0.05 s. First chapter card every 0.25 s; targeted extra samples enumerated per film.
methods.caption_rate: Same count as kit/tools/stats.js using each script strip(): remove Chinese comma/full stop/colon/semicolon/list comma and whitespace; A-Za-z . @ % ! _ - count 0.4, all other remaining characters count 1; Math.round per cue; divide by measured cue duration; median uses sorted[floor(n/2)].
methods.audio: ebur128=peak=true on delivered AAC; 2FA cross-checked with loudnorm input measurements; 2FA and luainstaller also measured using volumedetect; no audio or video file modified.
methods.chapter_windows: Conservative source-derived interval from specified text completing entrance animation until that text exits or the card begins occlusion. Excludes entrance/exit; not total visible duration and not an experimentally established reading threshold. First card visually sampled for cross-check.
